svg.text: Rule-based forwarding from a monitored Microsoft 365 mailbox · Hosted on Azure App Service
Source: Email Router Service — Technical Notes
Scope: Email forwarding and audit only

Single place for the service's settings — mailbox address, polling interval and database details.
Sensitive values are held as pointers to Key Vault rather than as plain text.
At startup the service fetches every expected setting and reports where each value came from.
The secure channel used to read
new mail and to forward it on
Always-on Python service, packaged as a container
Settings and secrets loaded at startup
Forwarded email delivered to the recipients named on the matching rule
The service authenticates as an application through
Entra ID — no user credentials are involved. The
access token is cached and reused between cycles.
The mailbox is checked on a fixed interval set in
configuration. The last-run marker advances only
after a successful cycle, so nothing is missed.
All traffic to the PostgreSQL database runs over
SSL, with credentials held in Key Vault rather than
Scope note: mailbox clean-up / deletion is non-functional and is excluded from this diagram, per the source technical notes. Only documented components and flows are shown.
